Walrein

Ice Water

Hoenn · Generation 3

Walrein is an Ice/Water-type Ice Break Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1.4 m tall and weighs 150.6 kg. It evolves from Sealeo. Its highest base stat is HP (110), with a base stat total of 530.
